review_scope: Post-measurement review of the sole cell above the frozen Phase 0.4 common-operation regression threshold.

accepted_exceptions.reason: The 0.4 NumPy-compatible arange API adds optional device and like controls, including validation, compared with baseline 1ca8824. On the 16-element cell the current call is 625 ns versus 458 ns at baseline (+167 ns, 1.365x; bootstrap ratio interval 1.362–1.600). This fixed sub-microsecond binding cost is accepted for the required API and error behavior; at 4,096 and 250,000 elements the same workload is faster than baseline. The preregistered manifest remains unchanged.
